assumptions: fixed row-stochastic P; dangling vertices modelled as absorbing self-loops
fixed intrinsic weights, per-node sum one, weights/values in [0,1]
attacker controls <= b ancestor groups with all-descendant control; controlled values arbitrary in [0,1] (0/1 extremes optimal by linearity, interior values sampled)
graph, weights, ancestry, thresholds unchanged; no graph-perturbation budget (graph_l1_budget=0)
supported: 2..15 source groups; exhaustive over all sizes when <=10 groups, sizes <=4 above
flip = any change of original actionable verdict, abstention included; abstain verdicts are never certifiable
limitations: Controlled synthetic instances, not real provenance.
Certificate semantics are restricted to the stated threat model; no claim under changed graph, weights or ancestry.
Exactness for >10 groups is limited to attack sizes <=4; larger costs are reported as lower bounds.
